Metadata.Comment: We install the default set of drivers as mentioned in the DefaultSelectionsPerVMFamily for each VM family. If the user wants to install GRID driver on NC or ND series, can do so by passing runtime settings on supported GPU VM families. For checking the supported VM families for a particular driver category, refer to SupportedVmFamilyAndGPUModel under each category below. For installing GRID driver on NC Series, please specify {'installGridNC':True} in the runtime setting. For installing GRID driver on ND series, please specify {'installGridND':True} in the runtime settings. Runtime settings can be provided from Azure CLI - (az vm extension set  --resource-group <rg-name> --vm-name <vm-name> --name NvidiaGpuDriverLinux --publisher Microsoft.HpcCompute --settings "{'installGridNC': True}"
